items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: At one time, I know some of the group had played with Pierron, like out at Spanish Fort.

ctx.x: At one time, I know some of the group had played with Pierron, like out at Spanish Fort. Did they ever have any long engagement anyplace, like any special club?
Well, that was a different outfit at the time. That was with Peter. Yeah. Peter played in that part. But that wasn't the rest. The Creole Serenaders consisted of his brothers.
